notes.title: Singleplayer Hotfix#1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225202/8731697ba2efb408f389cdf90d50005cc7120edc.png[/img]
-Single player difficulty slightly nerfed to ensure a fun and less punishing climb for hardcore players as well as casual players.
-New Mouse sensitivity slider visible in the pause menu can help everyone to enjoy more.
-Cinematics are now skippable.
-Slight performance upgrade.

notes.title: HOTFIX #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225202/fc03d0ea6815467601ff08e0f8301548b37bedf2.jpg[/img]
some problems are just [b]honest mistakes[/b], lobby password problem is now fixed and you can easily join lobbies.
patch notes has been added to main menu and a link to the game's discord channel where i will answer any questions and there will be PVP events and prizes in the upcoming competitions.
thank you for playing the game
